guarantees.claim: The state register st updates to st_d on every clock edge; on reset, st is set to StPadIdle.

assumptions.claim: st_d must be driven by a valid next‑state logic that respects pad_st_e encoding and ensures only legal state transitions.
assumptions.risk: If st_d is invalid or glitchy, the pad FSM may enter an illegal state, possibly corrupting padding behavior.
